title: Bootstrap Methods for Fuzzy Data
abstract: The bootstrap has been recognized as a universal method supporting statistical inference in situations where other approaches fail. In particular, the bootstrap appears also useful in fuzzy data analysis. In this paper, we make a review of the bootstrap methods oriented on statistical reasoning with random fuzzy samples. Moreover, we suggest a new flexible bootstrap approach designed for asymmetrical random fuzzy numbers. Finally, we compare the existing bootstrap approaches to provide some hints for practitioners.
